steam.title: Connect with Steam
steam.description: Connect your Steam account to prefill your avatar and nickname, and get ready to import your Steam library directly later.
steam.skipNote: You can skip this and keep using LastSave normally. Steam is not required to finish onboarding.

identity.title: Your identity
identity.subtitle: Choose a nickname and an optional avatar.

pcBuild.title: Your PC build
pcBuild.subtitle: Optional — we can try to detect it automatically.

genres.title: Favorite genres
genres.subtitle: Pick the genres you enjoy most. You can change these later.

favoriteGames.title: Favorite games
favoriteGames.subtitle: Pick up to {{max}} games from your catalog. You can skip this for now.

summary.title: All set!
summary.subtitle: Here's a summary of your profile. You can edit everything later.

handoff.title: Getting everything ready
handoff.message: Saving your profile and setting up your home. This only happens once.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Steam?
disconnect.message: This will remove your current Steam connection, clear the saved session, and reset the Steam-prefilled identity fields in this onboarding step.

errors.hardware: Could not detect your PC hardware right now.
errors.connectSteam: Could not connect your Steam account right now.
errors.disconnectSteam: Could not disconnect your Steam account right now.
errors.save: Something went wrong. Please try again.
